result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: truncated content in the restaurant cards that are cut off at the edges of the viewport, making some restaurant names and information unreadable.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is horizontally cut off, with 'Trattoria Piccol' text truncated and incomplete visibility of the card details
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has proper padding or the cards are fully visible within the viewport. Consider adjusting card width or implementing a proper carousel with navigation controls.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza place with ~0% discount) is partially cut off at the bottom of the visible area, making the restaurant name unreadable
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient vertical spacing or scroll area so all content cards are fully visible and readable. Adjust padding/margins or viewport height accordingly.
